ValidationRule.description: VR-OPP-01: Won Opportunity requires either a linked accepted Quote or a Booking Override Reason. Exception path for Rev Ops requires Booking_Override_Reason__c.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "5-Won"), NOT(ISCHANGED(StageName)), ISBLANK(SyncedQuoteId), ISBLANK(Primary_Quote__c), ISBLANK(Booking_Override_Reason__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A Won Opportunity requires either a linked accepted Quote (via Primary Quote) or a Booking Override Reason documenting why no Quote exists.
